sport.title: November 22, 2015: The day Novak Djokovic won a record fourth straight ATP World Tour Finals in London
paras: Every day Tennis Majors looks back at the biggest moments in tennis history. On November 22, 2015, Novak Djokovic capped an exceptional season by clinching a record fourth consecutive Masters title On this day, November 22, 2015, Novak Djokovic defeated Roger Federer in the final of the ATP World Tour Finals (6-3, 6-4).

Novak Djokovic was born in 1987 in Belgrade. He entered the top 100 in 2005, finishing the year as world No 83. In 2006, he announced his arrival on the big stage by reaching the quarter-finals at Roland-Garros while being ranked only No 63, after he beat world No 9 Fernando Gonzalez in the second round.

paras: Alexandra Eala has likely been enjoying a well-earned break from tennis of late, having played her last match of the season nearly two weeks ago now. sport.title: The ATP Finals has already proven who the real Grand Slam title contenders are for 2027
paras: The ATP Finals are already proving to be a real indicator of what could happen in the 2027 season. As is traditional, the ATP Finals are the final singles tournament on the calendar, pitting the top eight players against each other for one last time.

Given that the top eight players from the season have been competing in Turin, you would expect many of the matches to be close-fought. However, the round-robin stage has proven that not to be the case and it feels unlikely that this is going to change at the Grand Slams next year.
